briefdescription.para: Copy constructor for the Scene class is deleted to prevent copying of objects.

detaileddescription.para: The copy constructor for the Scene class is explicitly marked as deleted in order to prevent accidental copying of Scene objects. This is because the Scene class represents a complex data structure that should not be copied unintentionally, leading to unnecessary memory usage and potential issues with object state management.

Other
The Scene object to copy from.

briefdescription.para: Builds a scene and saves it in a file within the "BuiltScenes" directory.

detaileddescription.para: Checks if the "BuiltScenes" directory exists at the parent path of the project path. If not, creates this directory. Then writes the current scene object to a file with name equal to the scene's name and extension ".abs". Finally logs an info message indicating that the scene has been successfully built.

ProjectPath
The path of the project used to determine where to save the built scene files.
Builds the scene and saves it to a file in the "BuiltScenes" directory.

The function builds the current scene by writing its data into an abstract syntax tree (AST) format. The AST is saved as a file with the name of the scene, followed by ".abs". If the "BuiltScenes" directory does not exist, it will be created.

briefdescription.para: Duplicates an Entity in the Scene.

detaileddescription.para: This function duplicates a given Entity by creating a new one with the same name and copying all its components from the original Entity to the new one. The components copied are TransformComponent, SpriteRendererComponent, TileMapRendererComponent, CircleRendererComponent, AudioComponent, CameraComponent, NativeScriptComponent, RigidBody2DComponent, BoxCollider2DComponent, SegmentCollider2DComponent and CapsuleCollider2DComponent.

entity
The Entity to be duplicated.
Duplicates an Entity in the Scene.

This function duplicates an existing Entity by creating a new one with the same name and copying all its components from the original Entity. The copied components include TransformComponent, SpriteRendererComponent, TileMapRendererComponent, CircleRendererComponent, AudioComponent, CameraComponent, NativeScriptComponent, RigidBody2DComponent, BoxCollider2DComponent, SegmentCollider2DComponent and CapsuleCollider2DComponent.

parameterdescription.para: The Entity to be duplicated.
